title: Independent-universe ordinary ringed pullback and quotient/Roos models
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, and a scheme morphism r:S -> T, allowing independent universes for schemes and E [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme]. The ordinary ring pushforward is continuous ringed-topos direct image, and its left adjoint is ordinaryRingInverse. Finite coefficient maps preserve constant sections; their compatible limit map defines ordinaryCompletedRingMap, whose adjoint is ordinaryCoefficientMap. Ordinary module direct image uses this ring map; its left adjoint ordinaryPull has adjunction ordinaryAdjunction. Its additive complex functor is ordinaryComplexPull, and its total left-derived functor ordinaryDerivedPull has the specified ordinaryComplexCounit. The quotient augmentations and product augmentation define ordinaryCompletionChain as the explicit (quotient,zero) map to the Roos cocone [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. All these constructions are the existing item-owned constructions, relocated with identical signatures and bodies.
